target_customer: Non-engineers at companies using Zendesk, Salesforce and Slack who want to build their own apps
problem: Teams on Zendesk, Salesforce and Slack need small custom apps but lack engineers. Chaser let non-engineers build them without code.

founders.name: Albert Ho
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no background given.

founders.name: Tongbo Huang
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no background given.

technical_complexity.rationale: A no-code builder needs integrations with several platforms' APIs and an app runtime, a standard but nontrivial job for two people.

defensibility.rationale: The platforms themselves and other builders offered similar extensibility; no moat documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not found; the host platforms owned their own app and workflow tools, but no source describes a specific action.

market_need_then: The YC page says users built Zendesk, Salesforce and Slack apps without an engineering background. No demand data found.

brand_strength.rationale: Searches surface several unrelated Chaser brands (an invoice chasing company, a Toronto Slack task manager, a nightlife app), so the name was confusable and no brand material for this company was found.

outcome_analysis: Chaser was a two-person no-code app builder from Winter 2019 that YC now lists as inactive. No shutdown note, pivot report, acquisition or post-mortem was found, and no funding beyond the YC deal could be attributed to this company, so the cause of the failure is not public and no failure factors are assigned.
notes: Funding results (Fuel Ventures $4M, Wellfound $4.8M) belong to unrelated Chaser invoice software companies and were not attributed. Competitor list is empty: the one dated result found was Retool's August 2018 Launch HN for internal tools, which is adjacent rather than the same wedge, so it was not listed. Tool site not found, so the company website could not be fetched; YC listed no website.
